title: Veps people — Grokipedia
text: December 26, 2025 - The Veps, also known as Vepsians (Vepsä: vepsläizet), are a small indigenous Finno-Ugric ethnic group native to northwestern Russia, residing primarily along the borders of the Republic of Karelia, Leningrad Oblast, and Vologda Oblast.[1][2] Their language, Vepsian, belongs to the northern subgroup of the Finnic branch within the Uralic family, closely related to Finnish and Karelian, and is divided into three main dialects—Northern, Central, and Southern—corresponding to the subgroups' traditional territories around Lake Onega, the Svir River basin, and the Vologda region, respectively.
